visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A professional woman with short brown hair and glasses stands in a well-lit medical office, holding a handheld silver and black dermatoscope in her right hand and a small black wireless microphone in her left. She wears a cream-colored knit sweater and a silver bead necklace. The background features a white desk and blurred office decor. (2) A picture-in-picture overlay appears showing the same woman speaking on a stage. She demonstrates the dermatoscope by bringing it very close to her chest area, mimicking an examination. Animated gold coins fall from the top of the frame over her. (3) She switches to a larger, circular medical magnifying device (Wood's lamp) with a black handle. Close-up shots of a patient's facial skin are shown under deep blue-purple light, highlighting pores and textures. She holds the device up to her own face to show its size. (4) She holds both devices together for comparison, looking into the camera with an engaging expression. The background shows a white cabinet and a hint of a colorful painting. (5) The screen transitions to a static gray graphic with the 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC' logo, social media handles, phone numbers, and address details for two clinic locations in traditional Chinese and English.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Comparison of tools -> Technical demonstration -> Benefits -> Summary and CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is an educational promotion for DRX Dermatology Clinic. Dr. Chuang compares an expensive, traditional dermatoscope with a modern Wood's lamp, explaining how the latter improves diagnostic accuracy for conditions like acne and vitiligo while being less intrusive for patients. The goal is to demonstrate clinical expertise and advanced technology to attract potential patients.
